name: GE® 7.4 Cu. Ft. White Vented Gas Dryer
shortDescription: Eliminates the hassle of coins with the easiest, smartest, built-in QR code payment system. Offers tenants and guests a modern laundry experience that saves them time with secure contactless payment, cycle notifications, machine availability status, and more.

features.text: Built-In, Coinless Payment System
Eliminate the hassle of coins with the easiest, smartest, built-in QR code laundry POS system. 3rd party processing fees apply.
Launderday™ User App

Enhance the commercial laundry user experience with the Launderday™ User App. Offer tenants and guests access to contactless payment, cycle notifications and machine availability status for a modern laundry experience.
SmartHQ™ Management

SmartHQ™ Management offers owners database management for their commercial laundry. The Owner's Dashboard offers a centralized space for managing site revenues, machine status, pricing activities and refund requests.
Protected with Microban®
Antimicrobial technology is built in to critical areas of this ultrafresh commercial laundry, including the control panel and the lint filter of the dyer.
7.4 cu. ft. Capacity
Maximize revenue with a 7.4 cu. ft. capacity dryer that delivers the drying experience that tenants and guests expect.
Up to 120 ft. Venting
This commercial dryer with up to 120 foot venting size provides for optimal airflow, enhanced drying ability and flexible installation.
Service Priority
Receive timely response from a dedicated service support team
5 Year Limited Parts Warranty
Enjoy peace of mind thanks to this commercial laundry with 5-year limited parts warranty.
Parts Promise
The commercial laundry parts promise ensures that the most common components are on hand and available for shipment within one business day.
Commercial Grade Components

Enjoy lasting performance from built-to-last commercial laundry parts, including a heavy-duty agitator, fully front serviceable galvanized steel cabinet, cap-touch controls, 1/2 horsepower motor, stainless steel wash basket and metal transmission.
